data.long_meaning: The name Gavini is derived from the Greek word 'gavos' which means 'god'. The suffix 'ini' is derived from the Latin word 'inus' which means 'friend'. Thus, the name Gavini can be translated to 'friend of God'. The name Gavini carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gavini usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
